findings.detail: GUR was authored under constitution 1.2 and is revalidated under 1.4, not trusted on its declared version. 1.4 is not purely permissive over 1.2: it fixes citation cardinality at one locus per edge (DEC-2026-0008) and settles MODIFIES vs DERIVED_FROM for table lookups (DEC-2026-0011). Rows that were valid under 1.2 may fail here.
A1 omitted on Reviewer disposition: The rested-mind gate is already represented by canonical row 448. The proposed wording is a duplicate insertion.

A2 omitted on Reviewer disposition: Memorization does not consume the memorized spell on casting; casting does. Canonical row 256 already represents that operational dependency, so this reversed and reified restatement must be omitted.
A3 omitted on Reviewer disposition: Spell-book consultation gating memorization is already represented by canonical row 255.

A4 omitted on Reviewer disposition: Material components are supplied for clerical, druidic, and magical spell effects, not for memorization. The supported relationships are already represented by canonical rows 445, 446, 450, and 2647.
aspect is 5 words, constitution section 5 says 1-4: 'granting of the highest spells'

A6 omitted on Reviewer disposition: Spell memorization consuming preparation time is already canonical row 447. The proposed time_segment_round_turn target is additionally too narrow for minutes of game time.
